Students routinely pay for a diploma and then cannot proceed. Any institute that does not guarantee sponsorship in writing should be treated with suspicion. || [economics] The cost of entry is the part students underestimate. A DG Shipping approved pre-sea course is priced in lakhs whether it is the one-year diploma or the three-year degree, it is paid up front, and it does not guarantee the cadet berth that the certificate depends on. Money spent before sponsorship is money at risk. || [class12_prerequisite] PCM is required and so is a MEDICAL standard that no other profession in this dataset imposes: uncorrected 6/6 vision and no colour blindness. That excludes a large number of academically eligible students, and it should be checked before any money is spent. || [economics] Set level with Marine Engineer in Sector 2 rather than above it. Deck and engine officers hold parallel Certificates of Competency on the same ship under the same international convention, and a gap between them was not defensible. The highest earnings in this sector by a wide margin, and they are earned at sea in tax-advantaged foreign-going service, away from home for months. Shore roles after sailing pay substantially less, which is the trade every officer eventually makes. || [professional_sector] Built in Sector 16 and moved here on review. The substitution test decided it: remove travel and hospitality and a deck officer's work - navigation, watchkeeping, cargo, safety - survives completely unchanged, because a cargo ship carries no passengers to host. The setting was doing the work of a sector. It also ends a split that should never have existed: MARINE ENGINEER was already here, and the deck officer holds the parallel Certificate of Competency on the same ship. Two halves of one crew were in two different sectors.

one_liner: Designs physical products - appliances, tools, vehicles, medical devices, furniture.
job_roles: Industrial Designer | Product Designer (Hardware) | Furniture Designer | Transportation Designer | Toy Designer | CMF Designer | Packaging Structure Designer | Design Researcher | Model Maker & Prototyper
entrance_exams: UCEED | NID DAT | CEED
self_emp_route: Independent design consultancy serving manufacturers, normally after 5-8 years in-house - the work comes from a network, not a portfolio site.
ai_reason: The least exposed design profession here, because the output has to survive manufacture. A model can generate a beautiful kettle; it cannot know the tooling budget, the draft angles, the certification regime or what the factory can actually make. CMF Designer and Packaging Structure Designer are the more exposed roles; Design Researcher and Model Maker & Prototyper are the least.
role_spread: [Design Researcher] higher: verbal, emotional_intelligence, reasoning / lower: spatial || [Model Maker & Prototyper] higher: bodily, attention_span / lower: verbal
path_to_entry: class_11_12: Any stream. Physics and Maths help with the engineering side but are not required. -> entrance_exam: UCEED for the IITs, or NID DAT. Private design colleges admit on their own tests. -> degree: B.Des in Industrial or Product Design (4 years), or M.Des after any degree via CEED. -> work: In-house design team at a manufacturer, or a product design consultancy.
nuances: [entry_competition] UCEED is named as primary because for THIS profession the public design institutes really are the dominant route into the good jobs - unlike graphic or UI design, where entry is portfolio-led and the exam is irrelevant. 15,408 candidates for 245 seats is 62.9 to 1, harder than JEE Main. || [demand_signal] Moderate, and the reason is structural: India manufactures at enormous scale but designs comparatively little of what it makes, because design authority for many products sits with the foreign brand owner. That is a real ceiling on the profession's size, not a comment on its quality. || [professional_sector] Built in Sector 8 and moved here on review. The substitution test decides it: strip the styling and the object still has to be manufacturable, safe, durable and to cost - the engineering constraint is what survives, and it is what the job is actually bounded by. Its industrial tags were already CGSC, FFSC and ASDC: capital goods, furniture and automotive. THE COUNTER-ARGUMENT IS REAL AND IS WHY SECTOR 8 STILL POINTS HERE: the entrances are NID DAT and UCEED, which are design examinations, and a 15-year-old looking for this work will look under design, not under engineering. Placement follows the work; discoverability is the application's job.
